# Carl Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** Child / Pre-teen
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Glen St. Mary, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Student

## Appearance

Carl is a young, lively boy who frequently ends up disheveled from his outdoor pursuits. He is often seen carrying around various small creatures, bugs, or pets in his pockets. Despite his messy adventures, he has a pleasant, engaging face typical of the Meredith family.

## Personality

Carl is an enthusiastic naturalist with a deep, consuming passion for insects, reptiles, and all kinds of small animals. He is cheerful, affectionate, and good-natured, though his obsession with collecting creatures frequently gets him and his siblings into trouble. He is largely indifferent to social expectations and conventional propriety, prioritizing his live specimens above almost everything else.

## Traits

- Passionate about natural history and insects
- Good-natured and playful
- Absent-minded regarding rules and manners

## Abilities

- Finding and capturing small animals, insects, and reptiles

## Goals

- To collect and care for various biological specimens and pets

## History

Carl Meredith is introduced as one of the four motherless children of the new Glen St. Mary minister, John Meredith. Raised with little discipline due to his father's absent-minded nature, Carl spends much of his time playing in Rainbow Valley with his siblings and the Blythe children. His penchant for collecting bugs, frogs, and snakes repeatedly causes humorous chaos at the manse and during social calls. He joins the Good Samaritan Club formed by the manse children and their friends to help improve their behavior and perform good deeds. Along with his brother Gerald and sisters Jerry and Faith, Carl benefits greatly from the care and guidance of Rosemary West after she marries his father.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in the Glen St. Mary manse as the son of the Presbyterian minister, John Meredith.
- Lost his mother at a young age, leading to an upbringing largely unmonitored by strict parental oversight.

## Affiliations

- The Manse Children — Member
- The Good Samaritan Club — Member
